nodes.label:
Use Two Credentialed Clinical Databases
MIMIC-III v1.4 + MIMIC-IV v2.2
Preserve the Same Cohort Contract for All Models

Define Three Prediction Tasks
Length of Stay — Three Classes
Mortality + Readmission — Binary Classes

Filter the Patient Cohort
Keep First-time Visits Only
Exclude Age below 18 and Missing Values

Create Stratified Data Splits
Training • Validation • Test
Share Identical Splits across Model Families

Rebalance Training Labels Only
Apply Under-sampling to the Training Set
Leave Validation and Test Unchanged

Prepare Structured ML Features
Diagnoses • Procedures • Medications • Drugs
Retain Coded Clinical Variables

Convert Codes to LLM-readable Text
ICD-9/10 Diagnosis and Procedure Descriptions
ATC Medication and Drug Descriptions

Train 11 Traditional Models
LR • SVM • Trees • XGBoost • KNN
MLP • Transformer • RNN and Others

Evaluate 22 Language Models
14 General-purpose + 8 Medical LLMs
Compare Model Scale and Decoding Temperature

Test LLM Prompting Strategies
Direct • Chain-of-Thought • Self-reflection
Role-playing • In-context Learning

Test Task-specific Fine-tuning
Full and Partial LoRA Variants
Evaluate Data-scale Effects

Collect Held-out Predictions
Use the Same Validation/Test Cases
Compare ML and LLM Outputs Head to Head

Apply Task-specific Metrics
Length of Stay: Macro F1 + AUROC
Mortality/Readmission: F1 + AUROC

Report Repeated Comparisons
Five-run 95% Confidence Intervals
Confusion Matrices + Loss Curves + Findings
